name: Gererseul
positioning: Software for the landlord who has decided not to hire an agency — and needs the paperwork to be right anyway.
description: Gererseul provides French private landlords with lease creation, rent call and receipt generation, payment and arrears tracking, charge regularisation, indexation, and document templates for the standard events of a tenancy.
real_estate_use: Self-management fails on the events, not on the routine: the annual IRL indexation letter, the charge regularisation, the notice given in the correct form and delay. Gererseul's value is the template and the calendar around those moments, so a landlord does not discover a procedural defect at the tribunal.
features: Lease creation with the applicable French regime
Rent calls, receipts and payment tracking
IRL indexation calculation and notification letters
Arrears reminders and formal notice templates

use_cases.job: Apply the annual IRL indexation correctly and in the right form
Regularise charges against actual expenses at the end of the year
